question: EHCF is related to ILGJ in a certain way based on the English alphabetical order. In the same way, HKFI is related to LOJM. To which of the following options is MPKN related, following the same logic?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/2b15de16d396b52c68424915920e099dae05b94ac6a08cd00b03ee850fcc8e27.png] 

The logic followed here is:

EHCF is related to ILGJ

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c8a9360cde90fcb0c8ad093425ab87edff3acdc10b63b9221b85af259018acd6.png] 

HKFI is related to LOJM

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/8d1e174564653e3f3f8ce795bb7271b0ce4dc55034a49d5e8acd51d2c389d215.png] 

Similarly, MPKN will be related:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/fc0f5c440f7c29dcc45009c6e95fcc53fcb0311b62e7684b9200535ea4af59c0.png] 

Hence, the correct answer is "Option (4)".
